effective_regularization.dropout_interpretation: Native lora_llm omits lora_dropout when constructing LoraConfig: actual new adapter is 0.0 despite args .05. The entire model is not dropout-free: Conformer residual/feed-forward/convolution paths use .1.
effective_regularization.effective_freezing: After PEFT freezes the base, native lora_llm explicitly requires_grad_(True) on registered audio encoder/projector. Full audio modules and fresh LLM LoRA are trained.

loss.aggregation: Arithmetic means of existing logged optimizer-step windows ending in each interval; not fresh corpus-level loss.
loss.interpretation: Segments are broadly stable .0195-.0208. High teacher-forced token accuracy is not proof of correct autoregressive decoding or optimal training.

development_loss.interpretation: Two identical .04654206335544586 evaluations at final step 7507 with unchanged final weights; not an early-to-late development trend.

template_decode_review.training_structure: user head + speech features + fixed transcribe prompt + user end + assistant head + gold response + EOS
template_decode_review.decoding_structure: Same prompt prefix; generate continuation without reference
template_decode_review.alignment: Plugin validates placeholder count, forward asserts exact projected speech length equality, and existing CPU mixed-length tests cover feature replacement/masking/backward/reload. Tests read, not rerun here.
template_decode_review.finding: No obvious chat/EOS mismatch, inference reference leakage or speech alignment bug in reviewed paths. Training teacher forcing is intentional.
template_decode_review.normalization_buffers: Conformer batch_norm is nn.LayerNorm, not BatchNorm; dropping learned BatchNorm running_mean/var is not supported as an explanation.

target_audit.result: All normalized and prepared targets equal the raw transcript with whitespace removed; FireRed plugin clean_transcript changes zero additional target strings in this actual AISHELL training set.

prepared_structure.assistant_content: whitespace-stripped transcript only; no response prefix

target_audit.expected_template_tokens: The user <audio> marker is intentional. Plugin registers ChatML role boundaries and assistant <|im_end|> terminator during tokenization; these are template framing, not literal contamination in the prepared assistant text.
target_audit.plugin_cleaning_general_rule: clean_transcript can remove selected punctuation, normalize whitespace, and lowercase in general; direct application to every actual prepared AISHELL target made zero changes.
target_audit.supports_excluding: No evidence here for silent lexical rewrites by whitespace normalization, accidental assistant response prefixes, or literal template special tokens inserted into target text.
does_not_verify: Semantic correctness of transcripts against audio.
All runtime tokenized input_ids/labels, loss masks, attention behavior, or wrapper implementation.
Whether unusual official transcript strings represent genuine pronunciation, transcription convention, or annotation error.

frequency_method.text_preprocessing: Remove all whitespace with Python str.split/join from raw official reference; preserve all other characters. This exactly equals the verified prepared assistant target for all 120098 training records.
frequency_method.occurrences: Case-sensitive exact substring counts, Python str.count non-overlapping per utterance; sum across utterances.
frequency_method.utterances: Number of utterances containing the exact substring at least once.
frequency_method.rate_denominator: The corresponding split utterance count; counts also provide per-10000 utterance rates.
frequency_method.pair_share: Second-form occurrence count divided by both forms total count, not percentage of all sentences.
frequency_method.limitations: These are observed target text frequencies, not model token probabilities. Train/test differ in topics and corpus size; counts alone do not identify causal mechanisms or reveal any model pretraining corpus.

text_repetition_and_overlap.normalization: Remove whitespace only, retain all other characters; exact entire transcript equality.

supported_observations: Only 80 normalized outputs change versus original, down from 191 in the previous run.
77 previous regressed utterances are no longer worse than original; this does not imply all 77 become correct.
28 previous regressions persist and 17 new regressions occur.
The observed 20-error improvement does not establish stable improvement across training seeds.
interpretation.compatible_explanation: Supervised adaptation moves local word and spelling decisions; lower LLM learning rate makes this adaptation more conservative. Internal causes are not resolved.
unverified_candidates: Merging the official adapter then fitting a fresh rank8 adapter differs from continuing the official existing adapter.
Final checkpoint selection uses no development CER trajectory; overfitting has not been established.
boundaries: Old fixed-component interventions do not allocate the new residual 26 errors to the new LLM.
Even unchanged audio learning rates can yield different audio updates through joint-training gradients.
Speaker-cluster intervals describe test-composition sensitivity, not training-seed variance.
No audio audition or reference adjudication was performed.
Official inclusion of AISHELL-1 in pretraining is unknown.

learning_rate_only_followup.next_diagnostic: Compare original, checkpoint7000 and checkpoint7507 CER on dev, not test; separate future dropout or adapter-initialization contrasts.

external_primary_source.supports: Large-scale multi-source ASR training, transcript cross-entropy objective and reported AISHELL-1 performance; not local degradation causality.
